lean.quote: Remember a top priority here is to keep a more open mind to two sided trade returning to markets. Pullback buyers couldn't get the job done on Friday.
lean.note: Written after the worst session since Nov 2025; pathing given for both a weak open (732 support) and a strong open (fade 748.75).

calls.quote: Balance over 730 will prevent a deeper pullback.
If 730 breaks, looking for about 710-712.5 area for the ideal higher low.
If price opens weak on Monday, looking for 732 equal low support and initiating counter trend attempts on red to green moves.
If 732 breaks, looking to let price go, and then seek the lower high below for daily trend reversal and price to seek a weekly higher low.
Acceptance above 748.75 should be a big tell that the sell is not sustained, and the "infinibid™" is back on.
On opens higher towards 743.5 or the 20 SMA, looking for fades off of 748.75 to pullback and test the bear bar low.
